scripts.typecheck: for d in packages/*/ packages/*/*/ examples/*/; do if [ -f "$d/tsconfig.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && echo "[typecheck] $d" && if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"typecheck"' package.json; then bun run typecheck; else bunx tsc --noEmit; fi) || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.test:bun: bun run --cwd packages/tsx-bridge test:bun && bun run --cwd packages/targets/html test:bun && bun run --cwd packages/hosts/hono test:bun
scripts.test:grammar: moon run tree-sitter-solid:test --force && moon run tree-sitter-amx:test --force && moon run tree-sitter-mx:test --force
scripts.verify: bun run scripts/pre-verify.ts && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run test:sugar-module && bun run test:bun && bun run test:grammar && bun run consumer-check:html && bun run pack-probe && bun run --cwd apps/docs test && bun run --cwd apps/docs build && bun run scripts/verify-coverage.ts
scripts.build: cd packages/core && bun run build && cd ../targets/data && bun run build && cd ../../tsx-bridge && bun run build && cd ../../packages/targets/html && bun run build && cd ../../hosts/angular && bun run build && cd ../../../packages/tooling/vite-plugin && bun run build && cd ../language-server && bun run build && cd ../angular-checker && bun run build && cd ../typescript-plugin && bun run build && cd ../tsc && bun run build && cd ../../.. && bun run scripts/check-build-artifacts.ts
